title: Tax Refund Estimator 2025–26
summary: Estimate 2025-26 US Tax Refund. Non-official calculator for USA federal taxes.

This app is independently developed and is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, authorized by, or officially connected to the U.S. government, the Department of the Treasury, or the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).
This app does NOT provide government services, tax filing services, or official tax advice. It is intended for estimation and educational purposes only.

Get a quick and simple estimate of your Federal Tax Refund for the 2025-2026 tax season.
Are you filing your taxes in early 2026 and want to know how much money you might get back from the IRS? The Tax Refund Estimator 2025-26 helps you calculate your potential federal tax return or tax liability in just a few seconds. This app is specifically designed for taxpayers in the United States.
